newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile court rules against power cos in dispute.
newsitem.headline: Chile court rules against power cos in dispute.

text.p: Chile's Supreme Court has ruled in favour of the government in a dispute with three electricity companies over distribution tariffs, said Jaime Varela, a lawyer for the State Defence Council.
The court overturned decisions by a lower court in January in support of the firms Rio Maipo and Puente Alto, he said.
The court also modified a large part of the earlier ruling backing an appeal against the new rates by Chile's largest power distributor Chilectra.
Varela said the Supreme Court had rejected all of Chilectra's appeal except for the provisions relating to underground power facilities.
But "the underground facilities element has very little weight in the final issue of faxing tariffs," said Varela.
The companies had appealed against the method the government used to calculate new electricity distribution prices which were due to come into force in November.
Regulators had planned to make steep cuts in the rates which will be in force for the next four years.
